title: Green Line C Branch Fairbanks Street stop permanently closes November 7
summary: Green Line C Branch trains no longer stop at Fairbanks Street from 7 November 2026.

title: Iarnród Éireann publishes night-time track works schedule
summary: Iarnród Éireann published its schedule of planned overnight engineering work affecting rail services.

title: BART Green Line Weekend Closure for Train Control Upgrade
summary: The Green Line will not operate on the weekend of November 14-15, 2026, as BART installs new train control systems. Free shuttle buses will replace service between 24th St. Mission and Daly City.

title: MBTA prioritizes Green Line modernization work in November
summary: The MBTA noted major construction on the Green Line from 7 to 15 November 2026 as part of its modernization programme.

title: Late-night Yellow Line single tracking in Contra Costa County continues in November
summary: BART announced late-night single tracking on the Yellow Line to support its Digital Railway work, with work dates 2-6 November.

title: Red Line reaches 50 MPH between North Quincy and JFK/UMass
summary: Another Red Line segment between North Quincy and JFK/UMass is now cleared for trains running up to 50 MPH.

title: First major DART+ West enabling works to begin
summary: Work to lower the track on the M3 Parkway line has started, preparing the route for future electrification.

title: MBTA extends four ferry routes through the end of the year
summary: East Boston, Lynn, Winthrop and Quincy ferry service will now run until 31 December 2026.

title: MBTA to host two community meetings on Regional Rail modernization
summary: Community meetings on the regional rail modernization plan are scheduled for 4 and 17 November 2026.

title: Powell St. station entrance at 4th and Market closed Nov 2-10
summary: BART closed the Powell St. station entrance at 4th and Market from 2 to 10 November 2026.

title: Reduced Oakland Airport Connector Service During Maintenance
summary: Planned maintenance on the Oakland Airport connector will result in 9-minute average waits instead of the usual frequency, starting the night of November 14 through the following morning.

title: BART single tracking and Green Line cancellation on Oct 25 for vegetation management
summary: Service was reduced to one track between San Leandro and Bay Fair on Sunday 25 October 2026, with the Green Line cancelled.

title: Orange Line speeds increased to 55 MPH between Assembly and North Station
summary: Trains can now run at up to 55 MPH in both directions between Assembly and North Station.

title: MBTA outlines November construction: Green Line signals, accessibility, Red Line prep
summary: November work includes Green Line tunnel signal upgrades, accessibility improvements, switch work near Wonderland, Red Line signal prep and Commuter Rail improvements.

title: BART pilots Aira video interpreters for blind and low vision riders
summary: From October 6 through January 3, blind and low vision riders can use the free Aira Explorer app to reach live visual interpreters who help them find entrances, fare gates and platforms and board the right train.

title: Buses replace trains between 24th St. Mission and Daly City on November 14 and 15
summary: BART will run a bus bridge between 24th St. Mission and Daly City and cancel Green Line service on the weekend of November 14 and 15 while it works on the new train control system.
